Looking for portable cabins in Greater Noida? A portable cabin is a factory-built steel-frame and insulated-panel room that arrives ready to use, so you skip months of on-site construction. SAMAN manufactures these cabins at our own Greater Noida (Jalpura) factory, which sits right inside the region you are buying for. That means your cabin ships factory-direct, with no middleman markup and a short road haul to sites across Alpha, Beta, and Gamma sectors, Knowledge Park, and Pari Chowk.

Whether you need a site office, a security post, a staff room, or a warehouse management cabin, this guide explains the sizes, build specification, delivery timeline, and price factors so you can request an accurate quote.

Made in Greater Noida, delivered the same day

Most portable cabin suppliers truck units in from another city. We don't have to. Our manufacturing factory sits in Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, inside Gautambudha Nagar (201308) — the same district as your Greater Noida site. That means a finished cabin can reach an Alpha, Beta, Knowledge Park, or Pari Chowk address the same day it leaves the line, with the lowest freight of any city we serve. There is no long-distance transit cost added to your quote, and you can visit the factory to see your cabin before dispatch.

What Does a Portable Cabin in Greater Noida Cost?

There is no single fixed price for a portable cabin, because the cost depends on what you build. The main price factors are cabin size in square feet, panel thickness and insulation type, flooring grade, the number of doors and windows, electrical and plumbing fittings, any toilet or partition, the exterior finish, and the delivery distance from our factory. A bare single-room cabin costs far less than a fitted, air-conditioned office cabin of the same footprint. For an accurate figure, send your size and fit-out list and we will quote it. Delivery is ₹3,000 by default, billed on distance.

Portable cabin price guidance in Greater Noida

Most buyers want a starting figure before they enquire. Exact pricing depends on size, the wall panel you choose, the interior fit-out, and the site location — so the figures below are indicative starting points, not fixed quotes. We confirm the firm price at quotation, and because you are in the same district as our factory, transport adds the least here of anywhere.

As a guide, a compact 6x6 ft security or guard cabin typically starts around ₹1.25 lakh. A 10x10 ft single-room office works out higher once flooring, wiring, and windows are added. A 10x20 ft office with a built-in toilet block sits higher again, and a large 30x10 ft team office is at the top of the standard range. PUF sandwich panels cost more than single-skin or cement board but insulate far better. GST applies on top.

Portable cabin (indicative)Typical use
6x6 ftSecurity / guard cabin, site post
10x10 ftSingle-room site or warehouse office
10x20 ft with toiletStaff office with attached washroom
30x10 ftMulti-room team or admin office

Tell us your exact size and finish and we will send a clear, itemised quote.

Sizes and Common Uses

Portable cabins are built to your dimensions, from a compact 10x10 ft security post to a 40x60 ft administrative block. Below are the configurations Greater Noida buyers ask for most.

Site and Warehouse Offices

Logistics and factory operations in Knowledge Park and Alpha Sector use portable cabins as warehouse management and site offices. These include electrical points for computers, lighting, fans or AC provision, and reinforced flooring for office equipment. They give supervisors a clean, climate-controlled space without taking floor area from production.

Security Cabins and Staff Rooms

Factory gates across Beta and Gamma sectors use compact portable cabins as security checkpoints, with steel doors, glazed windows, and wiring ready for CCTV. The same cabins, scaled up, serve as worker rest rooms and changing areas with sanitation provision, improving comfort during long shifts.

How SAMAN Portable Cabins Are Built

Every cabin is built around a mild-steel frame fabricated to IS 2062 structural steel standards, then clad in roughly 50 mm insulated PUF sandwich panels (40 kg/m³ minimum core density) with a pre-galvanised steel skin. The roof uses GI sheeting with a slope for monsoon run-off, and steel members are powder-coated for corrosion resistance in industrial air. This dry-assembled construction is what lets a cabin be relocated within your plot or to a new site later, rather than being demolished like a brick room.

  • MS frame fabricated to IS 2062
  • ~50 mm insulated PUF sandwich wall panels for heat and sound control
  • GI sloped roofing with sealed windows and doors
  • Powder-coated steel and UV-resistant exterior coating
  • Reinforced flooring options for heavier equipment

Higher panel thickness, fire-retardant panels, and heavier electrical capacity are available on request. SAMAN works to an ISO 9001:2015 quality system.

Customisation options

Tell us how the cabin will be used and we build around it: split AC points and extra power sockets for office use, internal partitions for a separate cabin or meeting area, a toilet and washbasin block built into the unit, a glass front for a reception or gate cabin, loft storage above the ceiling line, and anti-skid flooring for workshop or wet areas. Because these are custom portable cabin options built to order in our own Greater Noida factory, they are made into the cabin, not added on afterwards.

Delivery and Installation to Greater Noida

Because our factory is in Greater Noida (Jalpura), your cabin does not travel across states to reach you — it dispatches from within the region. Standard cabins are delivered in about 3–5 days; custom or fully fitted units take longer to build before dispatch. Installation on a prepared, level site usually takes one to three days. A simple concrete pad or steel base is enough for most cabins; for short-term use, cabins can sit on leveled ground with support blocks. We can do a site assessment to confirm the right base for your location, whether that is Pari Chowk, Knowledge Park, or another industrial zone.

One Delhi-NCR-specific point worth knowing: during GRAP construction-ban windows (typically October to February), wet on-site construction can be restricted, while dry-assembly factory-built cabins are generally not barred — a practical reason buyers here choose prefabricated cabins.

Need a Portable Cabin in Greater Noida?

Tell us your size and fit-out and we will send a factory-direct quote.

Call +91 88616 22859

Why Buy Factory-Direct from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Private Limited has been serving India since 2009, incorporated in 2019. Buying direct from the manufacturer — and from a factory that is in your own region — means no dealer margin, faster coordination, and one party responsible for build, delivery, and after-sales. Our cabins carry a warranty of 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. (The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.) We also offer a 7-day return window from delivery or installation, with return transport at the customer's cost. SAMAN has completed 500+ projects across India.

You can explore the full range on our portable cabin collection, including the office portable cabin for fitted workspaces and the portable cabin with toilet for staff facilities.

FAQs


How quickly can you deliver a portable cabin in Greater Noida?

Standard cabins are usually delivered within about 3–5 days, since they dispatch from our Greater Noida factory. Installation on a prepared site adds roughly one to three days. Custom or fully fitted cabins need extra build time before dispatch — share your specification and we will confirm a realistic timeline for your site in Alpha, Beta, Gamma, or Knowledge Park.


What decides the price of a portable cabin?

Price depends on size, panel thickness and insulation, flooring grade, doors and windows, electrical and plumbing fittings, any toilet or partition, the finish you choose, and delivery distance. A bare single-room cabin is much cheaper than a fitted, air-conditioned office cabin of the same size. Send us your requirement and we will give you a clear, itemised quote.


What foundation does a portable cabin need at a factory site?

Most cabins sit on a simple concrete pad or a steel base frame. For short-term use, a leveled patch of ground with support blocks at load points is often enough. The exact requirement depends on soil, cabin size, and how long it will stay. Our team can assess your site before delivery to confirm the right base.


Can a portable cabin handle Greater Noida's summer heat and monsoon?

Yes. The ~50 mm PUF insulated panels reduce heat transfer in summer, and the sloped GI roof with sealed joints channels monsoon water away. UV-resistant exterior coating limits sun damage on open industrial plots. For very hot zones, you can add AC provision or thicker panels.


What is the warranty and expected life of a SAMAN cabin?

The warranty is 5 years on the structural frame and base plus 1–2 years on finishing, with a 20–25 year engineered service life for the structure. The galvanised steel frame resists corrosion, and powder-coated members hold up in industrial conditions. With basic maintenance, cabins stay in service for many years.

Get a Quote for Your Greater Noida Cabin

SAMAN builds and dispatches portable cabins from our own Greater Noida (Jalpura) factory to sites across Alpha, Beta, and Gamma sectors, Knowledge Park, and Pari Chowk. Tell us the size, use, and fit-out you need, and we will send a factory-direct quote with a realistic delivery timeline.

Ready to Order?

Speak to our team about your portable cabin requirement in Greater Noida.

Call +91 88616 22859   WhatsApp +91 88616 22859
